notes: Every object of the world verified with a fresh phone state (now = T0 + 1 h, or the next issuer epoch where `now` says so). Membership proofs are credentials.md presentations of the pinned entry policy, verified against the object's issued and the verifier version in force at its log position (ADR 0101); the BBS proof bytes and pseudonyms are fixed (P4 pending). The scope and bound-message bytes each proof covers are given in `scopes`. The log-submission cases are the log of record's own clock check.

cases.description: The response to a submission was lost; the phone asks the log of record for the old CID, finds it at its position, and does not rebuild
The log of record does not hold the old CID: the phone rebuilds with a fresh issued (a new CID, edit key and proof); an unsigned object keeps its slot
The rebuilt object was refused under IM-7: the first one was logged after all; the phone treats it as published and uses the next slot
